text:
anya: FYI we've got a latency spike on canary after last autotune run. Appears kernel choice flips for SM95/96 at seq len around 64-96 and KV cache warmup amplifies it.
kevin: ugh, when did this start? regression from which change?
anya: started after the kernel-picker change that introduced entropy-based tie-breaker (PR #4821). Noticed at 11:02 UTC on a dedicated pool.
mike: can you paste profiler output? microbench numbers please.
anya: sharing quick perf snippet from the canary node:
```
# microbench (seq=80, batch=4)
old-kern: 8.2 ms / token
new-kern: 12.7 ms / token
kv-cache-hit: 0.6 -> 0.3 after warmup thrash
GPU: SM95 driver 540.2, tensor-cores present, bf16 ok, fp8 path selected by capability flag
```
kevin: hmmm are we sure fp8 path is correct? earlier heuristics gated fp8 only for SM>=100 but the new capability mapping is looser.
anya: that's my suspicion — the capability fingerprint assigns `fp8=true` for some SM95 boards due to driver advert differences. The FP8 kernels have a higher dispatch overhead for these older hw which makes them slower for mid seqlen.
perf-bot: perf-alert: canary pool P-rt-3 increased p50 by 45% at 11:02 UTC, p95 by 80%.
sre-alerts: Is customer impact visible? any user-facing errors?
anya: no errors, only latency regressions. Some internal jobs timing out though.
devex: also seeing more `fallback-to-emu` logs in SDKs when we route to fallback paths. function-call latencies spike.
kevin: proposal: revert entropy tie-breaker and add an explicit backend capability matrix for FP8/BF16 selection per sm-range + driver-major. Also add hysteresis on seq-length gating (e.g., require 2 consecutive windows over threshold before switching kernel).
mike: +1. also add a KV warmup dampener: don't downgrade cache hit credit for first N batches after route change (N=10?).
anya: I'll open a quick patch:
```
- revert entropy tie-breaker (temp)
- add sm-range map:
  if sm_major <= 95 and driver < 541: prefer bf16-kernel
  else: fp8-path allowed
- seq-hysteresis: window=2, threshold=64
- kv-warmup-protect=N
```
kevin: can you run a perf diff with microbench harness (seq=32/64/80/128, batch 1..8) and include GPU hw id variance?
anya: on it. spinning up harness now.
perf-bot: note: please tag the run with `rt-kern-swing-1759999999` so CI can aggregate.
mike: after patch let's canary to dedicated-staging and monitor cost/throughput. If green, roll to canary pool and then prod.
anya: created issue + todo, will push draft PR and ping when perf-diff results are in. :thumbsup: 
kevin: thanks — good triage. keep SRE in the loop before any automated rollout.
sre-alerts: acknowledged, we'll hold auto-rolls and watch alerts.
anya: last note: we should add a fuzz test for driver-reported capability flags to prevent future misclassifications (randomize driver string + sm -> capability decisions).
kevin: agree. follow-up item for autotune tests.
anya: end of thread for now, will update with numbers.
